name: flux-priority
description: Relevance ranker. Scores files by mtime, extension, path depth, size and an interest profile, then emits them in priority order as Flux NDJSON.
notes: `verbs` is empty ON PURPOSE, not yet-to-be-written. `.rank` was added (hsh 8ffaa9c) and removed again on 2026-07-05: flux-priority is orchestration-shaped -- it needs a curated JSON interest profile, a scoring worldview, and the context of 'hot with respect to what' -- while the f<verb> family is mechanical, stateless and neutral. The practical part (recency order) is reproducible with existing combinators: feye('.').p_json().sort_by('modified').tail(N). The distinctive part (interest personalisation) belongs to Ariadne. Still a first-class pipe as a plain command: `flux-priority --since 24h`.
